measurements.cut: a question's whitespace-separated words w_1..w_n (n >= 5, asserted): prefix = the first int(0.6 n) words joined by single spaces, remainder = the rest joined by single spaces; both non-empty for n >= 2
measurements.EM_x: share of set x's items whose greedy continuation of the prefix, with whitespace collapsed to single spaces and stripped, equals the remainder or starts with the remainder followed by a space; new tokens per batch = the batch's longest remainder in tokens (tokenised with a leading space) + 8
measurements.SE: train, test, copy: binomial sqrt(p (1 - p) / n). floor: stdev over templates of each template's EM, divided by sqrt(T); None when T < 2
measurements.D_x: EM_x - EM_floor, absolute, x = train, test; SE = sqrt(SE_x^2 + SE_floor^2)
measurements.r: D_test / D_train, computed only when D_train >= 0.05; SE by the delta method, sqrt(SE_test^2 + r^2 SE_train^2 + (1 - r)^2 SE_floor^2) / D_train

gates.G1 (copy control): EM_copy >= 0.90; runs first and alone; fail: stop, nothing else is read
gates.G2 (positive control): D_train >= 0.05; not a stop: a failing control leaves a null on test unreadable but a high D_test still reads

rules.verdict: no reading if any of EM_train, EM_test, EM_floor is missing; else if D_train < 0.05: 'like train' if D_test >= 0.05, else 'no control'; else (control passes, r defined, D_train > 0): 'rare' if r <= 0.2, 'like train' if r >= 0.5, 'partial' strictly between. Negative r (test below the floor) is 'rare'
rules.edge cases checked on CPU before filing: an empty set gives EM None and verdict 'no reading'; D_train = 0 or negative gives 'no control' (no division); D_train exactly 0.05 passes the control (inclusive); r exactly 0.2 is 'rare' and exactly 0.5 'like train' (inclusive); no control with D_test exactly 0.05 is 'like train'; r above 1 (test above train) is 'like train'; a floor with one template gives SE None and every SE that uses it None, the verdict still reads from the point estimates; every case maps to exactly one of the five verdicts. The exact-match rule accepts every set's own remainder (1.000 on all four sets) and rejects a continuation that runs the remainder's last word into a longer one
rules.stage budgets: copy 120 s, train 300 s, floor 420 s, test 300 s; a stage stops before a batch that would pass its budget and records k; readings use the k reached
